newsHighlights.title: China boasts world's largest renewable energy system: report
newsHighlights.summary: A new report shows that China now has the world's largest renewable energy system, playing a leading role in the global green transition.
newsHighlights.translation: 最新报告显示，中国已建成全球最大的可再生能源体系，在全球绿色转型中发挥引领作用。

newsHighlights.title: Crested ibis-themed pavilion debuts at 9th CIIE
newsHighlights.summary: A pavilion themed on the crested ibis, a bird once on the brink of extinction, made its debut at the 9th China International Import Expo.
newsHighlights.translation: 以曾濒临灭绝的朱鹮为主题的展馆在第九届中国国际进口博览会上首次亮相。

newsHighlights.title: A new chapter begins: Giant pandas return to Zoo Atlanta
newsHighlights.summary: Giant pandas have returned to Zoo Atlanta, opening a new chapter in China-US wildlife conservation cooperation.
newsHighlights.translation: 大熊猫重返亚特兰大动物园，开启了中美野生动物保护合作的新篇章。

newsHighlights.title: When CIIE turns into an incubator?
newsHighlights.summary: At the Innovation Incubation Zone of the 9th CIIE, young tech entrepreneurs gather in Shanghai, seeking partners to turn green ideas into reality.
newsHighlights.translation: 在第九届进博会创新孵化专区，全球青年科技创业者齐聚上海，寻找合作伙伴，将绿色创意变为现实。

quote.quote: The greatest threat to our planet is the belief that someone else will save it.
quote.author: Robert Swan
quote.translation: 地球面临的最大威胁，是人们相信会有别人来拯救它。
quote.explanation: 这句话提醒我们：环境保护不是别人的责任，而是每个人的责任。正如今日新闻中中国建设全球最大可再生能源体系、保护朱鹮与大熊猫的行动所展示的，可持续发展需要每个国家、每个企业、每个个体从自身做起，主动行动而非等待他人。

vocabulary.example: China has built the world's largest renewable energy system.
vocabulary.translation: 中国建成了全球最大的可再生能源体系。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 CGTN 报道标题 "China boasts world's largest renewable energy system: report"。

vocabulary.example: Green technologies at the CIIE aim to support sustainable development worldwide.
vocabulary.translation: 进博会上的绿色技术旨在支持全球可持续发展。
vocabulary.newsContext: 与 CIIE 创新孵化专区报道中 "turn ideas into reality" 的绿色科技创业主题相关。

vocabulary.example: The return of giant pandas opens a new chapter in wildlife conservation cooperation.
vocabulary.translation: 大熊猫的回归开启了野生动物保护合作的新篇章。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 ChinaDaily 报道 "A new chapter begins: Giant pandas return to Zoo Atlanta"。

vocabulary.example: Protecting the crested ibis helps to preserve biodiversity in the region.
vocabulary.translation: 保护朱鹮有助于维护该地区的生物多样性。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 "Crested ibis-themed pavilion debuts at 9th CIIE" 一文中对濒危物种保护的报道。

vocabulary.example: Decades of habitat restoration brought the crested ibis back from the brink of extinction.
vocabulary.translation: 数十年的栖息地修复让朱鹮从灭绝边缘被拯救回来。
vocabulary.newsContext: 与朱鹮主题展馆新闻中物种恢复与栖息地保护内容相关。

vocabulary.example: Expanding renewable energy helps the country cut carbon emissions.
vocabulary.translation: 扩大可再生能源有助于该国减少碳排放。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 CGTN 关于中国可再生能源体系的报道背景。

vocabulary.example: The report marks a milestone in the global green energy transition.
vocabulary.translation: 这份报告标志着全球绿色能源转型的一个里程碑。
vocabulary.newsContext: 用于描述 China "boasts world's largest renewable energy system" 这一成就。

vocabulary.example: Ecological restoration has improved the habitat of many endangered birds.
vocabulary.translation: 生态修复改善了许多濒危鸟类的栖息环境。
vocabulary.newsContext: 与朱鹮主题展馆所体现的生态恢复成果相关。

vocabulary.example: A crested ibis-themed pavilion made its debut at the 9th CIIE.
vocabulary.translation: 一座朱鹮主题展馆在第九届进博会上首次亮相。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 ChinaDaily 报道 "Crested ibis-themed pavilion debuts at 9th CIIE"。

vocabulary.definition: 生态的（eco-，构成词如 ecosystem 生态系统）
vocabulary.example: The eco-friendly exhibits show how trade and nature can grow together.
vocabulary.translation: 这些环保展品展示了贸易与自然如何共同发展。
vocabulary.newsContext: 与进博会绿色展区及可再生能源、物种保护等新闻主题相关。

pattern.pattern: 主语 + boast + 宾语（以拥有……而自豪／拥有……）
pattern.example: China boasts the world's largest renewable energy system.
pattern.translation: 中国拥有全球最大的可再生能源体系。
pattern.usage: boast 在新闻英语中常表示「拥有（值得骄傲的事物）」，比 have 更有强调意味，多用于正面成就。常见搭配：boast the largest / the most advanced / a long history of 等。注意 boast 也可表示「吹嘘」，需根据语境判断褒贬。

grammar.title: 现在完成时（Present Perfect）在新闻中的运用
grammar.explanation: 现在完成时由 have/has + 过去分词构成，用于强调过去发生的动作对现在造成的影响或结果，或表示从过去持续到现在的状态。新闻报道常借助它来突出「刚刚发生且具有现实意义」的成就与变化，常与 already, just, so far, over the past...years, after... 等时间状语连用。
examples: The crested ibis population has recovered after decades of conservation.
China has built the world's largest renewable energy system, according to the report.

pronunciation.tips: 重音在第二个音节 /ˈsteɪn/ 上，首音节弱读为 /sə/。注意 /steɪ/ 中的双元音要饱满，结尾 /bl/ 轻快收尾，不要读成「sus-tain-a-ble」四个重音。可拆分练习：sə - STAY - nə - bl。
examples: Sustainable development is the theme of today's news.
The CIIE showcases sustainable technologies from around the world.

reading.title: Green Power and Winged Messengers: China's Sustainability Story
reading.content: China now boasts the world's largest renewable energy system, according to a recent report highlighted by CGTN. The achievement marks a milestone in the global green transition and shows how clean energy can grow alongside the economy. Nature protection is advancing just as quickly. At the 9th China International Import Expo, a crested ibis-themed pavilion made its debut, telling the story of a bird that was once on the brink of extinction and has since recovered thanks to decades of habitat restoration and conservation. Meanwhile, giant pandas have returned to Zoo Atlanta, opening a new chapter in wildlife cooperation between China and the United States. At the expo's Innovation Incubation Zone, young entrepreneurs are also turning green ideas into reality, from emission-cutting technologies to eco-friendly materials. Together, these stories show that sustainable development is not a distant goal, but a practical path built on energy, innovation and respect for nature.
reading.translation: 据 CGTN 近日报道，中国如今拥有全球最大的可再生能源体系。这一成就标志着全球绿色转型的里程碑，也表明清洁能源可以与经济增长并肩前行。自然保护同样进展迅速。在第九届中国国际进口博览会上，朱鹮主题展馆首次亮相，讲述了一种曾濒临灭绝、又因数十年栖息地修复与保护而重新恢复的鸟类的故事。与此同时，大熊猫重返美国亚特兰大动物园，开启了中美野生动物合作的新篇章。在进博会创新孵化专区，青年创业者们也在把绿色创意变为现实，从减排技术到环保材料，不一而足。这些故事共同表明：可持续发展并非遥远的目标，而是一条建立在能源、创新与尊重自然之上的切实之路。
reading.sourceNote: 本文基于 CGTN《China boasts world's largest renewable energy system: report》、ChinaDaily《Crested ibis-themed pavilion debuts at 9th CIIE》《A new chapter begins: Giant pandas return to Zoo Atlanta》《When CIIE turns into an incubator?》等 2026 年 11 月 9 日真实新闻改写，用于英语学习。
